aupVersion.title: AUP Version
aupVersion.description: Policy version string (e.g., '1.0' or '2026.1'). Incrementing this requires all users to re-sign even if previously accepted.

expirationDays.title: Signature Expiration (Days)
expirationDays.description: Number of days before an agreement expires and requires re-signing. Set to 0 to never expire (valid until version increment).

policyTitle.title: Policy Title
policyTitle.description: Title displayed at the top of the AUP agreement screen.

policyMarkdown.title: Policy Text (Markdown)
policyMarkdown.description: The Acceptable Use Policy content in Markdown format.

organizationName.title: Organization Name
organizationName.description: Name of the organization enforcing the policy.

logoUrl.title: Organization Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Direct HTTPS URL or base64 data URI of the organization logo.

triggerScope.title: Enforcement Trigger Scope
triggerScope.description: Choose 'all' to require AUP on any internet browsing, or 'pattern' to enforce only on specific internal/corp URLs.

triggerPatterns.title: Trigger URL Patterns
triggerPatterns.description: List of URL patterns (e.g. *://*.corp.company.com/*, *.internal) when triggerScope is 'pattern'.

whitelistPatterns.title: Whitelisted URL Patterns
whitelistPatterns.description: List of URLs exempt from AUP (e.g. SSO/Identity providers, Help Desk, webhook endpoint).

requireInitials.title: Require Drawn Initials
requireInitials.description: Require user to draw initials on canvas before allowing submission.

webhookUrl.title: Agreement Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL where agreement records and signature images are POSTed.

webhookAuthHeader.title: Webhook Authorization Header
webhookAuthHeader.description: Optional HTTP header value sent in Authorization header (e.g., 'Bearer <token>').
